item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 30/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be generally fine over Guangdong in the next few days. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region in the latter part of this week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week. It will be windier over the region.
